decisions.reason: Although the protection cap is a less central accessory with lower public commitment, the sunk costs and the possibility that weak initial sales are temporary lead the firm to keep it.
As a core box car trailer series prominently shown on the home page and central to the firm's strategy, the large investment and public commitment make dropping very unlikely.

The car transporter line is central to professional transport needs, and despite having only its own page rather than home-page placement, the firm's high investment and responsibility justify persistence.
The low-bed trailer series benefits from high visibility on the home page and aligns with the firm's quality and reliability focus, so escalation pressures strongly favor keeping it.
The high trailer cover series is publicly featured and complements the trailer portfolio, so management will likely continue supporting it to recoup its investment.
Despite possible overlap with Product B, the firm has committed publicly and invested in this box car series, so escalation of commitment leads to keeping it for now.
